Consolidated ATIF common-transcript stack. Workspace usage summarization, the driver's agent-reply detection, and the judge-transcript renderer now read both common-transcript vintages (legacy records and ATIF `step` records), with ATIF's cache-inclusive `prompt_tokens` converted so both vintages price identically. Delegation detection understands ATIF tool calls, matching worker-launch markers against the complete `arguments` object rather than a truncated preview.
